item.text:
ResStock **excludes dormitories and assisted care facilities, but includes high-rise apartment buildings**.

| Building type | Included? |
|---|---|
| Dormitories | No |
| Assisted care facilities | No |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes, as high-rise multifamily housing—even when building codes classify them as commercial buildings. |

ResStock follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a housing unit, which excludes congregate housing situations.

Source: [ResStock Technical Reference Guide, 2025 Release 1, Section 5 “Introduction,” p. 17](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=28).
